metadata.source: Classical Mythology (11th Edition), Morford, Lenardon, Sham

characters.name: Boreas
characters.description: God of the north wind, said to have carried off Oreithyia.

characters.name: Oreithyia
characters.description: A young girl carried off by Boreas.

characters.name: Socrates
characters.description: Greek philosopher, appears in Plato's Phaedrus discussing the myth of Boreas and Oreithyia.

characters.name: Phaedrus
characters.description: Character in Plato's dialogue, asks Socrates about the myth of Boreas and Oreithyia.

characters.name: Zeus
characters.description: King of the gods, mentioned in an oath by Phaedrus.
major_myths: Birth of the Dioscuri and Helen
Chariot Race of Pelops and Hippodamia
Homeric Hymn to the Supreme Son of Cronus
Quarrel of the Dioscuri with Idas and Lynceus
Sacred Marriage of Zeus and Hera
The Love Affair of Ares and Aphrodite
The Quarrel of Atreus and Thyestes
Theseus as Champion of the Oppressed

characters.name: Cronus
characters.description: Father of Zeus, deposed by Zeus according to Euhemerus.

characters.name: Ixion
characters.description: Mythological figure associated with the centaurs.

characters.name: Oedipus
characters.description: King of Thebes who slew his father Laius and wedded his mother Jocasta.
major_myths: Theseus as Champion of the Oppressed

characters.name: Laius
characters.description: Father of Oedipus, slain by Oedipus.

characters.name: Jocasta
characters.description: Mother of Oedipus, wedded by Oedipus.

characters.name: Heracles
characters.description: Hero who serves as a model of behavior.
major_myths: Heracles and the Apples of the Hesperides
Heracles and the Giants at Cyzicus

characters.name: Theseus
characters.description: Hero who serves as a model of behavior.
major_myths: Theseus as Champion of the Oppressed

characters.name: Apollo
characters.description: God who pursues Daphne in Ovid's Metamorphoses.
major_myths: Apollo Seeks a Site for His Oracle
Apollo and the foundation of Delphi
Apollo's Search for a Temple Site
Homeric Hymn to the Muses and Apollo
The Love Affair of Ares and Aphrodite

characters.name: Daphne
characters.description: Nymph pursued by Apollo in Ovid's Metamorphoses.

characters.name: Aphrodite
characters.description: Goddess who evokes passion; seduces Anchises.
major_myths: The Love Affair of Ares and Aphrodite

characters.name: Eros
characters.description: God who evokes passion.

characters.name: Artemis
epithets: Artemis who delights in her arrows
chaste virgin of the noisy hunt
huntress who delights in her arrows
she who delights in her arrows
characters.description: Goddess symbolizing chastity.

characters.name: Hippolytus
characters.description: Mortal who defines chastity in the story of Hippolytus and Phaedra.

characters.name: Phaedra
characters.description: Mortal who defines lust in the story of Hippolytus and Phaedra.

characters.name: Io
characters.description: Woman taken by force by Zeus; mother of Epaphus.

characters.name: Epaphus
characters.description: Son of Zeus and Io, born by the touch of Zeus's hand.

characters.name: Eos
characters.description: Goddess who pursues Cephalus and Tithonus.

characters.name: Cephalus
characters.description: Mortal pursued by Eos.

characters.name: Tithonus
characters.description: Mortal pursued by Eos.

characters.name: Salmacis
characters.description: Nymph who attacks Hermaphroditus.

characters.name: Hermaphroditus
characters.description: Innocent and pure youth attacked by Salmacis.

characters.name: Anchises
characters.description: Mortal seduced by Aphrodite.

characters.name: Hylas
characters.description: Handsome lad dragged down into depths by nymphs.

characters.name: Paris
characters.description: Trojan prince who woos Helen.

characters.name: Helen
characters.description: Wife of Menelaus who falls in love with Paris and goes to Troy willingly.

characters.name: Hades
characters.description: God who abducts Persephone to be queen of the Underworld.

characters.name: Persephone
characters.description: Daughter of Demeter, abducted by Hades to be queen of the Underworld.

characters.name: Demeter
epithets: bringer of goodly gifts in season
giver of goodly gifts in season
characters.description: Mother of Persephone, who disagrees with Hades' abduction.

characters.name: Ganymede
characters.description: Young man loved by Zeus, subject of a myth about male homosexuality.

characters.name: Poseidon
characters.description: God of the sea, involved in a male homosexual relationship with Pelops.
major_myths: Contest of Poseidon and Athena for Attica
The Love Affair of Ares and Aphrodite
The Race of Pelops and Oenomaüs

characters.name: Pelops
characters.description: Mortal loved by Poseidon, subject of a myth about male homosexuality.
major_myths: Chariot Race of Pelops and Hippodamia
The Race of Pelops and Oenomaüs

characters.name: Hyacinthus
characters.description: Young man loved by Apollo, subject of a myth about male homosexuality.

characters.name: Cyparissus
characters.description: Young man loved by Apollo, subject of a myth about male homosexuality.

characters.name: Achilles
characters.description: Greek hero, his friendship with Patroclus is a major theme of male homosexuality; also loves Briseïs.
major_myths: Judgment of the Arms of Achilles

characters.name: Patroclus
characters.description: Greek hero, close friend of Achilles, their relationship is a theme of male homosexuality.

characters.name: Orestes
characters.description: Son of Agamemnon, his friendship with Pylades is a theme of male homosexuality.

characters.name: Pylades
characters.description: Friend of Orestes, their relationship is a theme of male homosexuality.

characters.name: Nisus
characters.description: Roman legendary figure, his love and devotion to Euryalus is a moving example of male homosexuality.

characters.name: Euryalus
characters.description: Roman legendary figure, loved by Nisus.

characters.name: Sappho
characters.description: Lyric poetess from Lesbos, known for her poems about love for women.

characters.name: Briseïs
characters.description: Woman loved by Achilles in the Iliad.

characters.name: Priam
characters.description: King of Troy, husband of Hecuba.

characters.name: Hecuba
characters.description: Queen of Troy, wife of Priam.

characters.name: Hector
characters.description: Trojan prince, husband of Andromache.

characters.name: Andromache
characters.description: Wife of Hector.

characters.name: Ismene
characters.description: Daughter of Oedipus, devoted to him.

characters.name: Antigone
characters.description: Daughter of Oedipus, devoted to him and her brother Polynices.

characters.name: Eteocles
characters.description: Son of Oedipus, feuded with his brother Polynices.

characters.name: Polynices
characters.description: Son of Oedipus, feuded with his brother Eteocles.

characters.name: Tellus
characters.description: Athenian singled out by Herodotus as one of the happiest of men.
major_myths: The Meeting Between Solon and Croesus

characters.name: Cleobis
characters.description: One of the happiest of men according to Herodotus.
major_myths: The Meeting Between Solon and Croesus

characters.name: Biton
characters.description: One of the happiest of men according to Herodotus.
major_myths: The Meeting Between Solon and Croesus

characters.name: Minos
characters.description: Legendary king of Crete, friend of Zeus, associated with the Minoan civilization.

characters.name: Minotaur
characters.description: Half-bull, half-human monster kept in the labyrinth at Cnossus.

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.description: Greek hero of the Trojan War, protagonist of the Odyssey.
major_myths: Judgment of the Arms of Achilles
Odysseus and Ajax Compete for Armor
The Bow and the Killing of the Suitors

characters.name: Hera
characters.description: Listed as a pair with Zeus in Linear B tablets.
major_myths: Sacred Marriage of Zeus and Hera
The Meeting Between Solon and Croesus

characters.name: Hermes
characters.description: Name found in Linear B tablets.
major_myths: Polydectes and Perseus' Return to Argos
The Love Affair of Ares and Aphrodite

characters.name: Athena
characters.description: Name found in Linear B tablets.
major_myths: Contest of Poseidon and Athena for Attica
Judgment of the Arms of Achilles
Polydectes and Perseus' Return to Argos

characters.name: Eileithyia
epithets: goddess of the pangs of childbirth
characters.description: Name found in Linear B tablets as Eleuthia.

characters.name: Dionysus
characters.description: Name found in Linear B tablets; associated with Thebes where he was born.

characters.name: Enualios
characters.description: Name identified in classical times with Ares; appears in Linear B tablets.

characters.name: Ares
characters.description: Identified with Enualios in classical times.
major_myths: The Love Affair of Ares and Aphrodite

characters.name: Agamemnon
characters.description: Legendary hero associated with Mycenae.

characters.name: Nestor
characters.description: Legendary hero associated with Pylos; his palace was discovered by Blegen.

characters.name: Atreus
characters.description: Mythological family of Atreus ruled Mycenae; treasury of Atreus identified by Schliemann.
major_myths: The Quarrel of Atreus and Thyestes

characters.name: Clytemnestra
characters.description: Tomb of Clytemnestra erroneously identified by Schliemann.

characters.name: Cadmus
characters.description: Founder of Thebes; named by a Mycenaean king in a Hittite letter as a predecessor.
major_myths: Cadmus and the founding of Thebes

characters.name: Aeneas
characters.description: Ancestor of the imperial family of Augustus Caesar; honored at Troy.

characters.name: Augustus Caesar
characters.description: Roman emperor whose family claimed descent from Aeneas; honored Troy.

characters.name: Constantine the Great
characters.description: Roman emperor; Troy existed in his time.

characters.name: Ageläus
characters.description: One of Penelope's suitors in the Odyssey.

characters.name: Telemachus
characters.description: Son of Odysseus and Penelope, prince of Ithaca.
major_myths: The Bow and the Killing of the Suitors

characters.name: Penelope
characters.description: Wife of Odysseus, queen of Ithaca.
major_myths: The Bow and the Killing of the Suitors

characters.name: Pallas Athena
characters.description: Goddess of wisdom and war, instills laughter in the suitors.

characters.name: Theoclymenus
characters.description: A seer who prophesies doom for the suitors in the Odyssey.

characters.name: Xerxes
characters.description: King of Persia, visited Troy in 480 B.C. and sacrificed to Trojan Athena.

characters.name: Alexander the Great
characters.description: Macedonian king, visited the tomb of Achilles.

characters.name: Hephaestion
characters.description: Companion of Alexander the Great, compared to Patroclus.

characters.name: Appaliunas
characters.description: Hittite deity identified with Apollo, mentioned in the Alaksandu treaty.

characters.name: Phemius
characters.description: A bard in the Odyssey who sings of the disasters the Achaeans suffered upon their return from Troy.
major_myths: The Bow and the Killing of the Suitors

characters.name: Demodocus
characters.description: A bard in the Odyssey who sings about the wooden horse and the fall of Troy at Odysseus's request.

characters.name: Homer
characters.description: Poet who composed the Iliad and the Odyssey orally, possibly in the eighth century B.C., associated with Asia Minor or Chios.

characters.name: Chaos
characters.description: Primordial void or first principle from which all creation emerged.

characters.name: Gaia
characters.description: Primordial goddess of the earth, secure foundation of all.
major_myths: Sacred Marriage of Uranus and Gaia

characters.name: Tartarus
characters.description: Deep abyss in the depths of the earth, also personified as a primordial deity.

characters.name: Erebus
characters.description: Primordial darkness, the gloom of Tartarus, later equated with Tartarus itself.

characters.name: Night
characters.description: Primordial goddess of night, mother of Aether and Day by Erebus.

characters.name: Aether
characters.description: Primordial deity of the upper atmosphere, born from Night and Erebus.

characters.name: Day
characters.description: Primordial goddess of day, born from Night and Erebus.

characters.name: Uranus
characters.description: Primordial sky god, born from Gaia to cover and surround her.
major_myths: Sacred Marriage of Uranus and Gaia

characters.name: Pontus
characters.description: Primordial sea god, born from Gaia without union.

characters.name: Oceanus
characters.description: Titan god of the ocean stream that encircles the earth; mentioned in Homer and Aristophanes.

characters.name: Tethys
characters.description: Titaness, consort of Oceanus, responsible for origin of gods in Homer.

characters.name: Muses
characters.description: Nine goddesses of inspiration, daughters of Zeus, who taught Hesiod song.
major_myths: Homeric Hymn to the Muses and Apollo

characters.name: Hesiod
characters.description: Greek poet from Ascra, Boeotia, author of Theogony and Works and Days, inspired by the Muses.

characters.name: Perses
characters.description: Brother of Hesiod, who cheated him of his inheritance.

characters.name: Amphidamas
characters.description: Hero whose funeral games in Chalcis included a poetry contest won by Hesiod.

characters.name: Ovid
characters.description: Roman poet, author of Metamorphoses, which includes a creation account.

characters.name: Empedocles
characters.description: Fifth-century philosopher who theorized four basic elements (earth, air, fire, water).

characters.name: Phanes
characters.description: Orphic deity identified with Eros, the first-born who shone forth.

characters.name: Orpheus
characters.description: Legendary musician and poet associated with Orphism and mystery religions.

characters.name: Coeus
characters.description: Titan, son of Uranus and Gaia.

characters.name: Crius
characters.description: Titan, son of Uranus and Gaia.

characters.name: Hyperion
characters.description: Titan, god of the sun, son of Uranus and Gaia, mate of Theia, father of Helius, Selene, Eos.

characters.name: Iapetus
characters.description: Titan, son of Uranus and Gaia.

characters.name: Theia
characters.description: Titaness, daughter of Uranus and Gaia, mate of Hyperion, mother of Helius, Selene, Eos.

characters.name: Rhea
characters.description: Titaness, daughter of Uranus and Gaia, associated with fertility.

characters.name: Themis
characters.description: Titaness, daughter of Uranus and Gaia.
major_myths: Homeric Hymn to the Supreme Son of Cronus

characters.name: Mnemosyne
characters.description: Titaness, daughter of Uranus and Gaia, personification of memory.

characters.name: Phoebe
characters.description: Titaness, daughter of Uranus and Gaia.

characters.name: Brontes
characters.description: Cyclops, son of Uranus and Gaia, name means 'Thunder'.

characters.name: Steropes
characters.description: Cyclops, son of Uranus and Gaia, name means 'Lightning'.

characters.name: Arges
characters.description: Cyclops, son of Uranus and Gaia, name means 'Bright'.

characters.name: Cottus
characters.description: Hecatonchire, son of Uranus and Gaia, one of three hundred-armed, fifty-headed giants.

characters.name: Briareus
characters.description: Hecatonchire, son of Uranus and Gaia, one of three hundred-armed, fifty-headed giants.

characters.name: Gyes
characters.description: Hecatonchire, son of Uranus and Gaia, one of three hundred-armed, fifty-headed giants.

characters.name: Helius
epithets: lookout for both gods and human beings
characters.description: Sun-god, son of Hyperion and Theia (or Euryphaëssa), father of Phaëthon by Clymene.
major_myths: The Love Affair of Ares and Aphrodite

characters.name: Selene
characters.description: Moon-goddess, daughter of Hyperion and Theia (or Euryphaëssa).

characters.name: Euryphaëssa
characters.description: Wife of Hyperion, mother of Helius, Selene, and Eos; probably another name for Theia.

characters.name: Phaëthon
characters.description: Son of Helius and Clymene, challenged by accusation that Sun was not his father.

characters.name: Clymene
characters.description: Mistress of Helius, mother of Phaëthon.

characters.name: Acheloüs
characters.description: River god, son of Oceanus and Tethys.

characters.name: Leto
epithets: most renowned daughter of great Coeus
characters.description: Titaness, daughter of Coeus and Phoebe, mother of Apollo and Artemis by Zeus.

characters.name: Cybele
characters.description: Fertility goddess, identified with Rhea.

characters.name: Calliope
characters.description: Muse of epic poetry, daughter of Zeus.

characters.name: Vulcan
characters.description: Roman god of fire and metalworking, fashioned Helius' chariot.

characters.name: Jupiter
characters.description: Roman king of the gods, equivalent to Zeus.

characters.name: Leucothoë
characters.description: Eastern princess, daughter of Orchamus, loved by Helius.

characters.name: Orchamus
characters.description: Persian king, father of Leucothoë.

characters.name: Clytië
characters.description: Oceanid, lover of Helius, turned into a sunflower.

characters.name: Rhode
characters.description: Nymph of the island of Rhodes, loved by Helius.

characters.name: Endymion
characters.description: Handsome youth, lover of Selene, granted perpetual sleep and youth.

characters.name: Pandia
characters.description: Daughter of Zeus and Selene.

characters.name: Ge
characters.description: Primordial goddess of the earth, mother of the Titans.

characters.name: Erinyes
characters.description: Born from the blood of Uranus' severed genitals falling on Earth.

characters.name: Giants
characters.description: Born from the blood of Uranus' severed genitals falling on Earth.

characters.name: Meliae
characters.description: Nymphs of ash trees, born from the blood of Uranus' severed genitals.

characters.name: Cyclopes
characters.description: One-eyed giants, children of Uranus and Ge.

characters.name: Hecatonchires
characters.description: Hundred-handed giants, children of Uranus and Ge.

characters.name: Gaea
characters.description: Primordial earth goddess, mother of Cronus and Rhea; helped Rhea hide Zeus.

characters.name: Hestia
characters.description: First child of Cronus and Rhea, swallowed by Cronus.

characters.name: Curetes
characters.description: Attendants of Rhea-Cybele who played wild music; also received baby Zeus and hid him.

characters.name: Chronos
characters.description: Personification of time, sometimes confused with Cronus.

characters.name: Amalthea
characters.description: Goat that nursed Zeus on Crete.

characters.name: Hephaestus
characters.description: God of fire and metalworking, Roman name Vulcan.
major_myths: The Love Affair of Ares and Aphrodite

characters.name: Cycnus
characters.description: Cousin of Phaëthon, mourned him and turned into a swan.

characters.name: Danaüs
characters.description: From Egypt, visited Rhodes and founded temple of Athena at Lindos.

characters.name: Tlepolemus
characters.description: Son of Heracles, murdered his uncle and fled to Rhodes, led Rhodian contingent in Trojan War.

characters.name: Licymnius
characters.description: Uncle of Tlepolemus, murdered by him.

characters.name: Hecate
characters.description: Goddess of the moon, ghosts, and black magic, aspect of Selene and Artemis.

characters.name: Orion
characters.description: Beloved of Eos.

characters.name: Cleitus
characters.description: Beloved of Eos.

characters.name: Telchines
characters.description: Skilled craftsmen and metal-workers from Rhodes, had the evil eye, drowned by Zeus.

characters.name: Prometheus
characters.description: Titan, son of Iapetus and Clymene (Hesiod) or Themis (Aeschylus); creator of man; allied with Zeus in the Titanomachy.

characters.name: Atlas
characters.description: Titan, brother of Prometheus; fought for Cronus in the Titanomachy; punished by holding up the sky.
major_myths: The Origin of Libyan Snakes, the Atlas Range, and Coral

characters.name: Epimetheus
characters.description: Titan, brother of Prometheus; son of Iapetus and Clymene.

characters.name: Menoetius
characters.description: Titan, son of Iapetus and Clymene; brother of Prometheus, Epimetheus, and Atlas.

characters.name: Deucalion
characters.description: Son of Prometheus; husband of Pyrrha; survivor of the flood myth.

characters.name: Pyrrha
characters.description: Wife of Deucalion; daughter of Epimetheus and Pandora.

characters.name: Hellen
characters.description: Son of Deucalion and Pyrrha; ancestor of the Hellenes.

characters.name: Dorus
characters.description: Son of Hellen; ancestor of the Dorians.

characters.name: Aeolus
characters.description: Son of Hellen; ancestor of the Aeolians; keeper of the winds.

characters.name: Xuthus
characters.description: Son of Hellen; father of Achaeus and Ion.

characters.name: Achaeus
characters.description: Son of Xuthus; ancestor of the Achaeans.

characters.name: Ion
characters.description: Son of Xuthus; ancestor of the Ionians.

characters.name: Enceladus
characters.description: Giant imprisoned under Mount Aetna in Sicily after the Gigantomachy.

characters.name: Typhoeus
characters.description: Dragon-like monster with a hundred snake heads; youngest child of Ge and Tartarus; fought Zeus and was hurled into Tartarus.

characters.name: Notus
characters.description: God of the south wind; beneficial wind, not from Typhoeus.

characters.name: Zephyr
characters.description: God of the west wind; beneficial wind, not from Typhoeus.

characters.name: Otus
characters.description: Giant who attempted to storm heaven by piling mountains; sometimes linked to the Gigantomachy.

characters.name: Ephialtes
characters.description: Giant who attempted to storm heaven by piling mountains; sometimes linked to the Gigantomachy.

characters.name: Eumenes II
characters.description: King of Pergamum (181-158 B.C.); erected the Great Altar of Pergamum.

characters.name: Telephus
characters.description: Son of Heracles; subject of a smaller frieze on the Great Altar of Pergamum.

characters.name: Alcmena
characters.description: Mother of Heracles.

characters.name: Aidos
characters.description: Personification of shame or modesty; will forsake mortals in the Iron Age.

characters.name: Nemesis
characters.description: Personification of retribution; will forsake mortals in the Iron Age.

characters.name: Alcyoneus
characters.description: Giant; fought by Athena in the Gigantomachy; depicted on the Pergamon Altar.

characters.name: Nike
characters.description: Goddess of victory; depicted flying to crown Athena on the Pergamon Altar.

characters.name: Attalus III
characters.description: Last Attalid king; bequeathed Pergamon to Rome in 133 B.C.

characters.name: Pandora
characters.description: The first woman, created by Hephaestus and adorned by Athena and other gods. She brings a jar containing evils and hope, which she opens, releasing evils into the world.

characters.name: Graces
characters.description: Goddesses who adorn Pandora with golden necklaces.
major_myths: The Love Affair of Ares and Aphrodite

characters.name: Persuasion
characters.description: Goddess who adorns Pandora with golden necklaces.

characters.name: Seasons
characters.description: Goddesses who crown Pandora with spring flowers.

characters.name: Prometheus (Aeschylus)
characters.description: The version of Prometheus in Aeschylus' play Prometheus Bound, who gives mortals blind hopes and fire.

characters.name: Kratos
characters.description: Personification of Strength; brutish servant of Zeus.

characters.name: Bia
characters.description: Personification of Force; brutish servant of Zeus.

characters.name: Thetis
characters.description: Sea-nymph destined to bear a son mightier than his father; Zeus must avoid her.

characters.name: Argus
characters.description: Many-eyed giant set by Hera to guard Io; killed by Hermes; his eyes placed in peacock's tail.

characters.name: Inachus
characters.description: Father of Io; king of Argos; expelled Io on oracle's command.

characters.name: Chiron
characters.description: Centaur; wounded by Heracles; may have given up his life and immortality for Prometheus' release.

characters.name: Lycaon
characters.description: Wicked mortal punished by Zeus (Jupiter) for his evil; example of human wickedness in the Iron Age.

characters.name: Juno
characters.description: Roman goddess, wife of Jupiter; her messenger Iris draws up waters for the flood.

characters.name: Iris
characters.description: Goddess who draws up waters to nourish clouds during the flood.

characters.name: Neptune
characters.description: Roman god of the sea who aids Jupiter by sending waves and striking earth with trident.

characters.name: Triton
characters.description: Sea god who blows his conch to recall waves after the flood.

characters.name: Corycian nymphs
characters.description: Nymphs of Mount Parnassus worshipped by Deucalion and Pyrrha.

characters.name: Marduk
characters.description: Babylonian god who defeats Tiamat, similar to Zeus defeating Typhoeus.

characters.name: Tiamat
characters.description: Babylonian monster defeated by Marduk, resembling Typhoeus.

characters.name: Kumarbi
characters.description: Hittite god who defeats Anu by biting off his genitals, similar to Cronus castrating Uranus.

characters.name: Anu
characters.description: Sky god in Hittite myth, defeated by Kumarbi.

characters.name: Apsu
characters.description: Primordial fresh water god in Babylonian myth, destroyed by Ea.

characters.name: Ea
characters.description: Earth and wisdom god in Babylonian myth, destroys Apsu, father of Marduk.

characters.name: Enlil
characters.description: Babylonian god who orders creation of humans and sends the Flood.

characters.name: Kingu
characters.description: Leader of Tiamat's followers, killed to create humans.

characters.name: Atrahasis
characters.description: Babylonian wise man who survives the Flood.

characters.name: Geshtu-e
characters.description: God killed to create humans in Atrahasis myth.

characters.name: Gilgamesh
characters.description: King of Uruk, hero of the Epic of Gilgamesh, seeks immortality.

characters.name: Enkidu
characters.description: Rival and friend of Gilgamesh, created by gods.

characters.name: Ut-napishtim
characters.description: Babylonian flood survivor who lives immortal at the mouth of the rivers.

characters.name: Ishtar
characters.description: Goddess who desires to marry Gilgamesh and sends the Bull of Heaven.

characters.name: Humbaba
characters.description: Guardian of the Pine Forest, killed by Gilgamesh and Enkidu.

characters.name: Bull of Heaven
characters.description: Sent by Ishtar, killed by Gilgamesh and Enkidu.

characters.name: Ninurta
characters.description: Son of Enlil, identified with Heracles.

characters.name: Nergal
characters.description: Underworld god, consort of Ereshkigal, identified with Heracles.

characters.name: Ereshkigal
characters.description: Underworld goddess, consort of Nergal.

characters.name: Sinleqqiunninni
characters.description: Traditional author of the Epic of Gilgamesh.

characters.name: Maia
characters.description: Mother of Hermes by Zeus.

characters.name: Dione
characters.description: Mother of Aphrodite by Zeus (according to some traditions).

characters.name: Semele
characters.description: Mortal mother of Dionysus by Zeus.

characters.name: Metis
characters.description: First wife of Zeus, mother of Athena.

characters.name: Hebe
characters.description: Daughter of Zeus and Hera, goddess of youth.

characters.name: Hippodamia
characters.description: Wife of Pelops, worshiped at Olympia.
major_myths: Chariot Race of Pelops and Hippodamia
The Race of Pelops and Oenomaüs

characters.name: Oenomaüs
characters.description: Father of Hippodamia, challenged suitors to a chariot race.
major_myths: Chariot Race of Pelops and Hippodamia
The Race of Pelops and Oenomaüs

characters.name: Pirithoüs
characters.description: Lapith king, son of Ixion, whose wedding to Hippodamia was the setting for the centaur battle.

characters.name: Nephele
characters.description: Cloud created by Zeus in the likeness of Hera, impregnated by Ixion, mother of Centaurus.

characters.name: Centaurus
characters.description: Monster born from Ixion and Nephele, mated with mares to father the Centaurs.

characters.name: Philyra
characters.description: Nymph, mother of Chiron by Cronus.

characters.name: Jason
characters.description: Student of Chiron.

characters.name: Asclepius
characters.description: Student of Chiron.

characters.name: Caeneus
characters.description: Lapith, originally a girl named Caenis seduced by Poseidon, turned into an invulnerable man; died in the centaur battle.

characters.name: Caenis
characters.description: Original name of Caeneus before transformation.

characters.name: Mopsus
characters.description: Seer who announced Caeneus's transformation into a bird.

characters.name: Augeas
characters.description: King of Elis, whose stables were cleansed by Heracles.

characters.name: Niobe
characters.description: Mother whose children were killed by Apollo and Artemis.

characters.name: Trophonius
characters.description: Chthonic hero, son of Erginus, builder, swallowed by earth at Lebadeia.
major_myths: Apollo's Search for a Temple Site

characters.name: Agamedes
characters.description: Brother of Trophonius, builder, caught in a trap and beheaded.
major_myths: Apollo's Search for a Temple Site

characters.name: Erginus
characters.description: Father of Trophonius and Agamedes, king of Orchomenus.

characters.name: Hyrieus
characters.description: Boeotian king for whom the treasury was built (alternative version).

characters.name: Amphiaraüs
characters.description: Seer, one of the Seven against Thebes, swallowed by earth.

characters.name: Melampus
characters.description: Seer with power to understand animal speech.
major_myths: Melampus and the Cattle of Phylacus

characters.name: Bias
characters.description: Brother of Melampus.
major_myths: Melampus and the Cattle of Phylacus

characters.name: Tiresias
characters.description: Priest and seer in the Theban saga.

characters.name: Promeneia
characters.description: Eldest priestess at Dodona.

characters.name: Timarete
characters.description: Priestess at Dodona, next in age.

characters.name: Nicandra
characters.description: Youngest priestess at Dodona.

characters.name: Ammon
characters.description: Egyptian god, oracle at Libya sacred to Zeus.

characters.name: Tros
characters.description: Father of Ganymede, king of Troy.

characters.name: Scamander
characters.description: River god who fought Achilles and was overcome by Hephaestus's fire.

characters.name: Diomedes
characters.description: Greek hero who wounds Ares in the Iliad.

characters.name: Clio
characters.description: One of the nine Muses, presides over history (or lyre playing).

characters.name: Euterpe
characters.description: One of the nine Muses, presides over lyric poetry (or tragedy and flute playing).

characters.name: Melpomene
characters.description: One of the nine Muses, presides over tragedy (or lyre playing).

characters.name: Terpsichore
characters.description: One of the nine Muses, presides over choral dancing (or flute playing).

characters.name: Erato
characters.description: One of the nine Muses, presides over love poetry (or hymns to the gods and lyre playing).

characters.name: Polyhymnia
characters.description: One of the nine Muses, presides over sacred music (or dancing).

characters.name: Urania
characters.description: One of the nine Muses, presides over astronomy.

characters.name: Thalia
characters.description: One of the nine Muses, presides over comedy.

characters.name: Fates
characters.description: Three goddesses responsible for the destiny of every individual: Clotho (Spinner), Lachesis (Apportioner), Atropos (Inflexible). Daughters of Zeus and Themis (or Night and Erebus).

characters.name: Clotho
characters.description: One of the three Fates, spins out the thread of life.

characters.name: Lachesis
characters.description: One of the three Fates, measures the thread of life.

characters.name: Atropos
characters.description: One of the three Fates, cuts the thread of life, bringing life to an end. Characterized as the smallest and most terrible.

characters.name: Hours
characters.description: Daughters of Zeus and Themis, also called Horae, become the Seasons, goddesses who are two, three, or four in number and closely connected with vegetation.

characters.name: Eunomia
characters.description: One of the Hours, personification of Good Order.

characters.name: Dike
characters.description: One of the Hours, personification of Justice.

characters.name: Eirene
characters.description: One of the Hours, personification of Peace.

characters.name: Aglaea
characters.description: One of the Graces, youngest, sometimes mate of Hephaestus.

characters.name: Charis
characters.description: Personification of Grace, sometimes mate of Hephaestus, possibly another designation for Aphrodite.

characters.name: Perseus
characters.description: Greek hero who slew Medusa with help from Athena.
major_myths: Polydectes and Perseus' Return to Argos
The Origin of Libyan Snakes, the Atlas Range, and Coral

characters.name: Medusa
characters.description: Gorgon, slain by Perseus, her head depicted on Athena's aegis.
major_myths: The Origin of Libyan Snakes, the Atlas Range, and Coral

characters.name: Pierus
characters.description: Father of nine daughters who challenged the Muses and were turned into magpies.

characters.name: Tyche
characters.description: Personification of Luck or Fortune.

characters.name: Ananke
characters.description: Personification of Necessity.

characters.name: Silenus
characters.description: Companion of Dionysus, imagined as Ganymede by the Cyclops.

characters.name: Cyclops
characters.description: One-eyed giant, imagines Silenus as his Ganymede.

characters.name: Peleus
characters.description: Mortal father of Achilles.

characters.name: Xenophanes
characters.description: Pre-Socratic poet and philosopher, criticized anthropomorphic gods.

characters.name: Aeschylus
characters.description: Greek playwright, author of Agamemnon.

characters.name: Sophocles
characters.description: Greek playwright, author of Antigone.

characters.name: Protagoras
characters.description: Fifth-century sophist, proclaimed 'Man is the measure of all things.'

characters.name: Solon
characters.description: Athenian lawgiver and wise man who travels to the court of Croesus.
major_myths: The Meeting Between Solon and Croesus

characters.name: Croesus
characters.description: Wealthy king of Lydia at Sardis.
major_myths: The Meeting Between Solon and Croesus

characters.name: Atys
characters.description: Son of Croesus; his death is part of the story of Croesus.

characters.name: Amasis
characters.description: King of Egypt; Solon visited his court.
major_myths: The Meeting Between Solon and Croesus

characters.name: Cyrus
characters.description: Persian king; appears in the story of Croesus.

characters.name: Adrastus
characters.description: Son of Gordias, grandson of Midas, a Phrygian who accidentally killed his brother and later killed Atys, then committed suicide.
major_myths: Theseus as Champion of the Oppressed

characters.name: Cyrus the Great
characters.description: King of the Persians who conquers Lydia and captures Croesus.

characters.name: Tellus the Athenian
characters.description: The happiest of men according to Solon, a Greek who fought at Marathon.

characters.name: Candaules
characters.description: King of Lydia, boasted of his wife's beauty, killed by Gyges.

characters.name: Gyges
characters.description: Bodyguard of Candaules, forced to kill him and marry the queen.

characters.name: Arion of Lesbos
characters.description: Musician, inventor of the dithyramb, saved by a dolphin.

characters.name: Periander
characters.description: Tyrant of Corinth, friend of Arion.

characters.name: Polycrates
characters.description: Tyrant of Samos, known for his wealth and his ring returned by a fish.

characters.name: Oroetes
characters.description: Persian who murdered Polycrates.

characters.name: Icarius
characters.description: Legendary figure associated with Anthesteria myth.

characters.name: Erigone
characters.description: Daughter of Icarius; associated with Anthesteria myth.

characters.name: Calchas
characters.description: Legendary seer, model for historical seers.

characters.name: Stratios
characters.description: Son of Nestor, leads the sacrificial animal by the horns.

characters.name: Echephron
characters.description: Son of Nestor, leads the sacrificial animal by the horns.

characters.name: Aretus
characters.description: Son of Nestor, brings lustral water and a basket of barley-grains.

characters.name: Thrasymedes
characters.description: Son of Nestor, holds the ax to fell the animal.

characters.name: Eurydice
epithets: eldest of the daughters of Clymenus
characters.description: Wife of Nestor, participates in the sacrifice.

characters.name: Peisistratus
characters.description: Son of Nestor, cuts the animal's throat.

characters.name: Nereus
characters.description: Eldest son of Pontus and Ge, gentle, wise, true, with gift of prophecy.

characters.name: Doris
characters.description: An Oceanid, mother of the Nereids by Nereus.

characters.name: Galatea
characters.description: A Nereid, loved by Polyphemus but loved Acis.
major_myths: Acis, Galatea, and the Cyclops Polyphemus

characters.name: Amphitrite
characters.description: A Nereid, wife of Poseidon, jealous and vengeful.

characters.name: Polyphemus
characters.description: Son of Poseidon, a Cyclops who loved Galatea.
major_myths: Acis, Galatea, and the Cyclops Polyphemus

characters.name: Acis
characters.description: Son of Faunus and Symaethis, loved by Galatea, transformed into a river-god.
major_myths: Acis, Galatea, and the Cyclops Polyphemus

characters.name: Faunus
characters.description: Father of Acis.

characters.name: Symaethis
characters.description: A sea-nymph, daughter of river-god Symaethus, mother of Acis.

characters.name: Symaethus
characters.description: River-god in Sicily, father of Symaethis.

characters.name: Tyro
characters.description: Daughter of Salmoneus, loved by Poseidon, mother of Neleus and Pelias.

characters.name: Salmoneus
characters.description: Father of Tyro.

characters.name: Enipeus
characters.description: Thessalian river, disguised by Poseidon to seduce Tyro.

characters.name: Neleus
characters.description: Son of Poseidon and Tyro, twin of Pelias.
major_myths: Melampus and the Cattle of Phylacus

characters.name: Pelias
characters.description: Son of Poseidon and Tyro, twin of Neleus.

characters.name: Proteus
characters.description: Sea divinity, attendant or son of Poseidon, can change shape and foretell the future.

characters.name: Eidothea
characters.description: Daughter of Proteus, helped Menelaüs consult Proteus.

characters.name: Menelaüs
characters.description: Greek hero on his way home from Troy, consulted Proteus.

characters.name: Scylla
characters.description: Daughter of Phorcys and Hecate, transformed into a monster with dogs' heads; also a version where she was loved by Glaucus.

characters.name: Charybdis
characters.description: Daughter of Poseidon and Ge, a voracious monster who swallows and spews water three times a day.

characters.name: Phorcys
characters.description: Son of Pontus and Ge, father of Scylla (with Hecate).

characters.name: Glaucus
characters.description: Mortal changed into a sea-god, loved Scylla.

characters.name: Circe
characters.description: Sorceress who fell in love with Glaucus and poisoned Scylla's waters.

characters.name: Thaumas
characters.description: Son of Pontus and Ge.

characters.name: Ceto
characters.description: Daughter of Pontus and Ge.

characters.name: Eurybië
characters.description: Daughter of Pontus and Ge.

characters.name: Electra
characters.description: Mated with Thaumas.

characters.name: Harpies
characters.description: Birdlike creatures with women's faces, violent winds, sisters of Iris.

characters.name: Graeae
characters.description: Three sisters, personifications of old age, with one eye and one tooth shared among them.

characters.name: Gorgons
characters.description: Three sisters (Stheno, Euryale, Medusa) with serpent hair; those who look at them turn to stone.

characters.name: Stheno
characters.description: One of the Gorgons.

characters.name: Euryale
characters.description: One of the Gorgons.

characters.name: Pegasus
characters.description: Winged horse, born from Medusa's corpse.

characters.name: Chrysaor
characters.description: Son of Medusa and Poseidon, born from Medusa's corpse; father of Geryon and Echidna by Callirhoë.

characters.name: Ladon
characters.description: Dragon, son of Phorcys and Ceto; guarded the golden apples of the Hesperides; slain by Heracles.
major_myths: Heracles and the Apples of the Hesperides

characters.name: Hesperides
characters.description: Nymphs who guarded a tree with golden fruit in the West.
major_myths: Heracles and the Apples of the Hesperides

characters.name: Callirhoë
characters.description: An Oceanid, mate of Chrysaor, mother of Geryon and Echidna.

characters.name: Geryon
characters.description: Monster, son of Chrysaor and Callirhoë; owned the hound Orthus.

characters.name: Echidna
characters.description: Half nymph, half snake; mother of many monsters by Typhon and Orthus.

characters.name: Typhon
characters.description: Monster, mate of Echidna, father of Orthus, Cerberus, Hydra, and Chimaera.

characters.name: Orthus
characters.description: Hound of Geryon, son of Echidna and Typhon; father of the Sphinx and Nemean Lion with Echidna.

characters.name: Cerberus
characters.description: Hound of Hades, son of Echidna and Typhon.

characters.name: Lernaean Hydra
characters.description: Monster, offspring of Echidna and Typhon.

characters.name: Chimaera
characters.description: Monster, offspring of Echidna and Typhon.

characters.name: Theban Sphinx
characters.description: Monster, offspring of Echidna and Orthus.

characters.name: Nemean Lion
characters.description: Monster, offspring of Echidna and Orthus.

characters.name: Sirens
characters.description: Bewitching creatures whose lethal song lures sailors to destruction.

characters.name: Aegeus
characters.description: Athenian king, father of Theseus (human father).
major_myths: Theseus as Champion of the Oppressed

characters.name: Erechtheus
characters.description: Ancient king of Athens, associated with Poseidon.

characters.name: Nereids
characters.description: Fifty sea nymphs, daughters of Nereus and Doris.

characters.name: Antaeus
characters.description: Giant, son of Poseidon and Ge, encountered by Heracles.

characters.name: Arion
characters.description: Wonderful horse, offspring of Poseidon and a mortal woman.

characters.name: Cretheus
characters.description: Founder and king of Iolcus, husband of Tyro, father of Aeson, Pheres, and Amythaeon.

characters.name: Aeson
characters.description: Son of Cretheus and Tyro, father of Jason.

characters.name: Pheres
characters.description: Son of Cretheus and Tyro, founder of Pherae, father of Admetus.

characters.name: Amythaeon
characters.description: Son of Cretheus and Tyro.

characters.name: Admetus
characters.description: Son of Pheres, husband of Alcestis; performed task of harnessing a lion and boar to a chariot.

characters.name: Alcestis
characters.description: Wife of Admetus, recovered from the Underworld by Heracles.

characters.name: Cecrops
characters.description: Mythical king of Athens; judged the contest between Athena and Poseidon.
major_myths: Contest of Poseidon and Athena for Attica

characters.name: Pallas
characters.description: Daughter of Triton; playmate of Athena, accidentally killed by Athena during a quarrel.

characters.name: Arachne
characters.description: A skilled weaver from Lydia who challenged Athena to a weaving contest and was punished.

characters.name: Idmon of Colophon
characters.description: Father of Arachne, a dyer of wool.

characters.name: Pheidias
characters.description: Greek sculptor who created the Athena Parthenos and the statue of Zeus at Olympia.

characters.name: Pericles
characters.description: Athenian general and statesman who initiated the building program including the Parthenon.

characters.name: Gustav Klimt
characters.description: Austrian painter who created Pallas Athena, an icon for the Vienna Secession.

characters.name: Marsyas
characters.description: Satyr who picked up the flute discarded by Athena.

characters.name: Saturn
characters.description: Titan, father of Jupiter, mentioned in Arachne's tapestry.

characters.name: Bellerophon
characters.description: Greek hero; protected by Athena.

characters.name: Furies
characters.description: Primordial goddesses of vengeance; appeased by Athena in the Oresteia.

characters.name: Praxiteles
characters.description: Sculptor who established the nude type of Aphrodite.

characters.name: Horae
characters.description: Daughters of Zeus and Themis; attendants of Aphrodite, often identified with seasons.

characters.name: Zephyrus
characters.description: West Wind; brings Aphrodite to Cyprus.

characters.name: Priapus
characters.description: Fertility god, son of Aphrodite; deformed with huge phallus; guardian of gardens and doors.

characters.name: Pan
characters.description: Possible father of Priapus.
major_myths: The Quarrel of Atreus and Thyestes

characters.name: Adonis
characters.description: Handsome youth, son of Myrrha and Cinyras; lover of Aphrodite; killed by a boar.

characters.name: Pygmalion
characters.description: Sculptor who fell in love with his ivory statue; prayed to Venus; statue became real.

characters.name: Paphos
characters.description: Son of Pygmalion and Galatea; gave name to the city Paphos.

characters.name: Cinyras
characters.description: Son of Paphos; father of Myrrha and Adonis; unknowingly committed incest with Myrrha.

characters.name: Myrrha
characters.description: Daughter of Cinyras; fell in love with her father; changed into a myrrh tree; mother of Adonis.

characters.name: Astarte
characters.description: Phoenician goddess confused with Aphrodite; shared love for Adonis.

characters.name: Mentha
characters.description: Maiden transformed into mint by Persephone.

characters.name: Attis
characters.description: Handsome youth, son of Nana, lover of Cybele, castrated himself and died.

characters.name: Nana
characters.description: Daughter of the river god Sangarios, mother of Attis.

characters.name: Sangarios
characters.description: River god, father of Nana.

characters.name: Galli
characters.description: Eunuch priests of Cybele.

characters.name: Otreus
characters.description: Father of the mortal persona Aphrodite assumed, ruler of Phrygia.

characters.name: Dardanus
characters.description: Ancestor of Anchises, son of Dardanus is a patronymic for Anchises.

characters.name: Aristophanes
characters.description: Comic playwright; gives a speech on love in Plato's Symposium.

characters.name: Agathon
characters.description: Dramatic poet; host of the Symposium.

characters.name: Pausanias
characters.description: Guest at the Symposium; gives a speech on love.

characters.name: Eryximachus
characters.description: Guest at the Symposium; gives a speech on love.

characters.name: Sileni
characters.description: Creatures associated with Hermes; make love to nymphs in caves.

characters.name: nymphs
characters.description: Mountain nymphs who raise Aeneas; live long lives; associated with trees.

characters.name: Diotima
characters.description: Woman of Mantinea who instructs Socrates about the true nature of Eros.

characters.name: Resourcefulness
characters.description: Son of Cleverness (Metis); father of Eros by Poverty.

characters.name: Poverty
characters.description: Mother of Eros by Resourcefulness.

characters.name: Cleverness
characters.description: Mother of Resourcefulness.

characters.name: Psyche
characters.description: A mortal princess of surpassing beauty; beloved of Cupid; undergoes trials to achieve union with him.

characters.name: Cupid
characters.description: Roman name for Eros; son of Venus; falls in love with Psyche.

characters.name: Venus
characters.description: Roman goddess; mother of Cupid; becomes jealous of Psyche's beauty.

characters.name: Alcibiades
characters.description: Athenian statesman; in Symposium, tells of his failed attempts to seduce Socrates.

characters.name: Aristotle
characters.description: Greek philosopher; described his god as the unmoved mover.

characters.name: Plato
characters.description: Greek philosopher; author of Symposium and Republic; developed concept of Platonic Eros.

characters.name: Apuleius
characters.description: Roman author of the second century A.D.; wrote Metamorphoses (The Golden Ass) which contains the story of Cupid and Psyche.

characters.name: Mercury
characters.description: Messenger god, sent by Jupiter to proclaim the capture of Psyche.

characters.name: Charon
characters.description: Ferryman of the Underworld, to be paid for passage.

characters.name: Bacchus
characters.description: God of wine, serves nectar at the wedding feast.

characters.name: Psyche's sisters
characters.description: Two jealous sisters of Psyche who die by leaping from a mountain.

characters.name: satyr
characters.description: A satyr plays the pipes at the wedding feast.

characters.name: Pleasure
characters.description: Daughter of Cupid and Psyche, called Pleasure (Voluptas).

characters.name: Phryne
characters.description: Courtesan, model for Praxiteles' Aphrodite.

characters.name: Tammuz
characters.description: Consort of Ishtar, dying and rising god.

characters.name: Poros
characters.description: Personification of resource, father of Eros in some accounts.

characters.name: Penia
characters.description: Personification of poverty, mother of Eros in some accounts.

characters.name: Actaeon
characters.description: Grandson of Cadmus, an ardent hunter who accidentally saw Artemis bathing and was transformed into a stag and killed by his own hounds.

characters.name: Autonoë
characters.description: Mother of Actaeon.

characters.name: Callisto
characters.description: Follower of Artemis who was seduced by Jupiter and transformed into a bear; later became the constellation Ursa Major.

characters.name: Arcas
characters.description: Son of Callisto and Jupiter; nearly killed his mother in bear form; became the constellation Arctophylax (Boötes) or Ursa Minor.

characters.name: Oenopion
characters.description: King of Chios; father of Merope; blinded Orion.

characters.name: Merope
characters.description: Daughter of Oenopion; wooed by Orion.

characters.name: Pleiades
characters.description: Daughters of Atlas and Pleione; pursued by Orion and transformed into constellations.

characters.name: Pleione
characters.description: Oceanid mother of the Pleiades.

characters.name: Sirius
characters.description: Orion's dog, transformed into the Dog Star constellation.

characters.name: Alpheus
characters.description: River-god who loved the nymph Arethusa.

characters.name: Arethusa
characters.description: Follower of Artemis (or Artemis herself according to Telesilla); transformed into a stream to escape Alpheus.

characters.name: Iphigenia
characters.description: First priestess of Artemis at Brauron; buried there according to Euripides.

characters.name: Pittheus
characters.description: King of Troezen, raised Hippolytus.

characters.name: Chariclo
characters.description: Nymph, mother of Tiresias, companion of Athena.

characters.name: Medea
characters.description: Sorceress, patron deity of sorceresses, associated with Hecate.
major_myths: Theseus as Champion of the Oppressed

characters.name: John the Baptist
characters.description: Biblical figure, compared to Hippolytus for his misogyny.

characters.name: Salome
characters.description: Biblical figure, daughter of Herodias.

characters.name: Herodias
characters.description: Biblical figure, mother of Salome.

characters.name: Nurse
characters.description: Phaedra's nurse, who reveals Phaedra's love to Hippolytus and is denounced by him.

characters.name: Sinis
characters.description: Robber killed by Theseus at the Isthmus of Corinth.

characters.name: Sciron
characters.description: Brigand killed by Theseus on the cliffs that bear his name.

characters.name: Cypris
characters.description: Goddess of love, also known as Aphrodite, who caused Phaedra's passion for Hippolytus.

characters.name: Britomartis
characters.description: Nymph associated with Crete, possibly a manifestation of Artemis.

characters.name: Amphion
characters.description: Husband of Niobe, ruler of Thebes.

characters.name: Tantalus
characters.description: Father of Niobe, punished in the underworld.

characters.name: Aristaeus
characters.description: Father of Actaeon.

characters.name: Opis
characters.description: Follower of Artemis, possibly a manifestation of the goddess.

characters.name: Asterie
characters.description: Mother of Hecate, sister of Leto.

characters.name: Anius
characters.description: Son of Apollo. Associated with Delos.

characters.name: Macar
characters.description: Son of Aeolus, associated with Lesbos.

characters.name: Elaïs
characters.description: Daughter of Anius, received from Dionysus the power of producing oil.

characters.name: Spermo
characters.description: Daughter of Anius, received from Dionysus the power of producing grain.

characters.name: Oeno
characters.description: Daughter of Anius, received from Dionysus the power of producing wine.

characters.name: Ge-Themis
characters.description: Great mother-goddess of the Minoan-Mycenaean period; originally occupied the site of Delphi.

characters.name: Pythia
characters.description: Prophetess of Apollo at Delphi who uttered the god's responses from the tripod.

characters.name: Cumaean Sibyl
characters.description: Prophetess at Cumae who guided Aeneas; granted long life by Apollo but not eternal youth.

characters.name: Chaerephon
characters.description: Friend of Socrates who consulted the Delphic oracle.

characters.name: Helenus
characters.description: Seer who warned Aeneas about the Sibyl's leaves.

characters.name: Cassandra
characters.description: Daughter of Priam; given gift of prophecy by Apollo but cursed that no one would believe her.

characters.name: Marpessa
characters.description: Daughter of Evenus; wooed by Apollo and Idas; chose Idas.

characters.name: Evenus
characters.description: Son of Ares; father of Marpessa; committed suicide after Idas took Marpessa.

characters.name: Idas
characters.description: One of the Argonauts; wooed and married Marpessa.
major_myths: Quarrel of the Dioscuri with Idas and Lynceus

characters.name: Cyrene
characters.description: Athletic nymph loved by Apollo; mother of Aristaeus.

characters.name: Peneus
characters.description: River god; father of Daphne.

characters.name: Python
characters.description: Serpent slain by Apollo at Delphi.

characters.name: Diana
characters.description: Goddess of hunting; companion of Daphne.

characters.name: Coronis
characters.description: Lovely maiden from Larissa in Thessaly, loved by Apollo and pregnant with his child; killed by Apollo for infidelity.

characters.name: Machaon
characters.description: Son of Asclepius, a heroic physician mentioned in the Iliad.

characters.name: Archinus
characters.description: Dedicator of a votive relief to Amphiaraüs; depicted in the healing process.

characters.name: Midas
characters.description: King of Phrygia. Judged Pan's music superior to Apollo's, causing Apollo to give him ass's ears. His barber revealed the secret through reeds.

characters.name: Tmolus
characters.description: A mountain god who served as judge in the musical contest between Apollo and Pan.

characters.name: Phlegyas
characters.description: King, father of Coronis.

characters.name: Tityus
characters.description: Attempted to rape Leto; shot down by Apollo and punished in Hades.

characters.name: Thanatos
characters.description: Personification of death, wrestled by Heracles for the life of Alcestis.

characters.name: Moirai
characters.description: Three goddesses of fate. Apollo induced them to grant Admetus longer life.

characters.name: Olympus
characters.description: A mortal dear to Marsyas, wept for him after his flaying.

characters.name: Hippocrates
characters.description: Great physician of the fifth century B.C., founded a medical school at Cos, moved medicine out of temples.

characters.name: Crito
characters.description: Friend of Socrates, asked to pay a cock to Asclepius.

characters.name: Chryses
characters.description: Priest of Apollo who appealed to the god to plague the Greeks at Troy.

characters.name: Harmonia
characters.description: Goddess of harmony, who dances with Apollo.

characters.name: Ischys
characters.description: Son of Elatus, rival of Apollo in love.

characters.name: Elatus
characters.description: Father of Ischys.

characters.name: Phorbas
characters.description: Son of Triops, rival of Apollo in love.

characters.name: Triops
characters.description: Father of Phorbas.

characters.name: Ereuthus
characters.description: Rival of Apollo in love.

characters.name: Leucippus
characters.description: Rival of Apollo in love; Apollo wooed the wife of Leucippus.

characters.name: Azan
characters.description: Father of a daughter whom Apollo wooed.

characters.name: Christ
characters.description: Central figure of Christianity, contrasted with Apollo in the text.

characters.name: Telphusa
characters.description: A nymph associated with a spring; she deceives Apollo into not building his temple at her site.
major_myths: Apollo's Search for a Temple Site

characters.name: She-Dragon
characters.description: A huge, bloated, fierce she-dragon slain by Apollo at Delphi; she had raised Typhaon.

characters.name: Typhaon
characters.description: Monster born to Hera without Zeus, given to the she-dragon to raise; a scourge for mortals.

characters.name: Cretans
characters.description: Men from Minoan Cnossus who become Apollo's priests at Delphi.

characters.name: Phemonoë
characters.description: First Pythia, name means 'Prophetic Mind'; poetic figure.

characters.name: Deïphobe
characters.description: Sibyl, daughter of Glaucus, priestess of Phoebus Apollo and Diana.

characters.name: Ajax
characters.description: Son of Telamon; Greek hero in Trojan War; his suicide produced the hyacinth flower.
major_myths: Judgment of the Arms of Achilles
Odysseus and Ajax Compete for Armor

characters.name: Euripides
characters.description: Greek playwright; wrote about Apollo in Iphigenia in Tauris.

characters.name: Herodotus
characters.description: Historian; recorded names of later Pythias.

characters.name: Diodorus Siculus
characters.description: Historian; wrote about the oracle at Delphi.

characters.name: Plutarch
characters.description: Philosopher and biographer; wrote about the oracle in Moralia.

characters.name: Vergil
characters.description: Roman poet; his works were used as oracles (sortes Vergilianae).

characters.name: Petronius
characters.description: Roman author; wrote about the Sibyl in Satyricon.

characters.name: Winckelmann
characters.description: Art historian; wrote History of the Art of Antiquity.

characters.name: holy sisters
characters.description: Three winged sisters who live under a ridge of Mt. Parnassus, masters of divination. They feed on honey and tell truth when inspired, lies when deprived.

characters.name: Daphnis
characters.description: Sicilian shepherd, son of Hermes and a nymph, inventor of pastoral music.

characters.name: Thoth
characters.description: Egyptian god equated with Hermes as Hermes Trismegistus.

characters.name: Polycles
characters.description: Greek sculptor who made a statue of Hermaphroditus.

characters.name: Megamedes
characters.description: A figure not found elsewhere; mentioned in a note.

characters.name: Alcithoë
characters.description: A woman who tells the story of Hermaphroditus and Salmacis to her sisters.

characters.name: Ino
characters.description: Sister of Semele, daughter of Cadmus, cared for the infant Dionysus.

characters.name: Pentheus
characters.description: King of Thebes, grandson of Cadmus, son of Agave, opposed Dionysus and his worship.

characters.name: Agave
characters.description: Daughter of Cadmus, mother of Pentheus, sister of Semele, driven mad by Dionysus.

characters.name: Ariadne
characters.description: Wife of Dionysus, mentioned in the reenactment of their marriage.

characters.name: Echion
characters.description: One of the earthborn men, father of Pentheus.

characters.name: Agenor
characters.description: Father of Cadmus, mentioned as coming from Sidonia.

characters.name: Corybantes
characters.description: Ecstatic attendants of Cybele, invented the drum and flutes for Bacchic rites.

characters.name: Satyrs
characters.description: Mythical companions of Dionysus, took up the drum from Rhea.

characters.name: Maenads
characters.description: Female followers of Dionysus, known for ecstatic frenzy.

characters.name: Proetus
characters.description: King of Tiryns in Argos; his daughters resisted Dionysus and were driven mad.

characters.name: Iphinoë
characters.description: Daughter of Proetus; died during the pursuit by Melampus and his men.

characters.name: Minyas
characters.description: King of Orchomenus in Boeotia; his daughters refused to participate in Bacchic worship and were driven mad.

characters.name: Leucippe
characters.description: Daughter of Minyas; bore a son named Hippasus who was torn to pieces.

characters.name: Hippasus
characters.description: Son of Leucippe; torn to pieces by the maenads.

characters.name: Lycurgus
characters.description: King of Thrace; pursued the nurses of Dionysus with an ox goad; struck blind by Zeus and died soon after.

characters.name: Zagreus
characters.description: Another name for Dionysus; son of Zeus and Persephone; dismembered by Titans and reborn.

characters.name: Titans
characters.description: Monstrous beings; attacked and devoured Zagreus; destroyed by Zeus; from their ashes humans were born.

characters.name: Thyone
characters.description: Name given to Semele after Dionysus brought her back from the dead.

characters.name: Maira
characters.description: Dog of Erigone.

characters.name: Pactolus
characters.description: River near Sardis where Midas cleansed himself; its sands became golden.

characters.name: Syrinx
characters.description: Nymph devoted to Artemis; transformed into marsh reeds to escape Pan.

characters.name: Echo
characters.description: Nymph who fled from Pan; torn to pieces by shepherds; only her voice remained.

characters.name: Dryope
characters.description: Daughter of Dryops; mother of Pan by Hermes.

characters.name: Dryops
characters.description: Father of Dryope.

characters.name: Phidippides
characters.description: Runner sent to Sparta; encountered Pan.

characters.name: Beroë
characters.description: Child of Aphrodite; foundation myth for Berytus.

characters.name: Narcissus
characters.description: Son of Cephisus and Liriope, a beautiful youth who rejected all lovers and fell in love with his own reflection, leading to his death.

characters.name: Cephisus
characters.description: River-god who raped the nymph Liriope, father of Narcissus.

characters.name: Liriope
characters.description: Nymph raped by Cephisus, mother of Narcissus.

characters.name: Jove
characters.description: Roman name for Zeus; he lay with nymphs on the mountain, and Echo helped them escape Juno.

characters.name: Naiads
characters.description: Water nymphs, sisters of Narcissus, who mourned his death.

characters.name: Dryads
characters.description: Tree nymphs who wept for Narcissus.

characters.name: Celeus
characters.description: King of Eleusis, father of four daughters and a baby son. He hosts Demeter in disguise.

characters.name: Metaneira
characters.description: Wife of Celeus, mother of their children. She welcomes Demeter as a nurse.

characters.name: Callidice
epithets: most beautiful of the daughters of Celeus
characters.description: Daughter of Celeus and Metaneira, one of the four sisters who meet Demeter at the well.

characters.name: Cleisidice
characters.description: Daughter of Celeus and Metaneira, one of the four sisters.

characters.name: Demo
characters.description: Daughter of Celeus and Metaneira, one of the four sisters.

characters.name: Callithoë
characters.description: Daughter of Celeus and Metaneira, the oldest of the four sisters.

characters.name: Iambe
characters.description: Servant in the house of Celeus who sets a chair for Demeter.

characters.name: Triptolemus
characters.description: One of the men of Eleusis mentioned by Callidice as having great honor and power.

characters.name: Dioclus
characters.description: One of the men of Eleusis mentioned by Callidice.

characters.name: Polyxeinus
characters.description: One of the men of Eleusis mentioned by Callidice.

characters.name: Eumolpus
characters.description: One of the men of Eleusis mentioned by Callidice.

characters.name: Dolichus
characters.description: One of the men of Eleusis mentioned by Callidice.

characters.name: Persaeus
characters.description: Father of Hecate (also known as Perses).

characters.name: Demophoön
characters.description: Son of Celeus and Metaneira, nursed by Demeter who attempted to make him immortal.

characters.name: Plutus
characters.description: God of wealth, offspring of Demeter and Iasion.

characters.name: Iasion
characters.description: Lover of Demeter, father of Plutus.

characters.name: Diocles
characters.description: One of the kings taught Demeter's mysteries.

characters.name: Phaeno
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Ianthe
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Melite
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Iache
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Rhodeia
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Melobosis
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Ocyrhoë
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Chryseïs
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Ianeira
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Acaste
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Admete
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Rhodope
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Pluto
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates (not to be confused with Hades' Roman name).

characters.name: Calypso
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Styx
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Galaxaura
characters.description: One of Persephone's playmates.

characters.name: Iacchus
characters.description: Another name for Dionysus, associated with the Eleusinian Mysteries, leads the procession.

characters.name: Niinnion
characters.description: Woman who dedicated the Niinnion Pinax at Eleusis.

characters.name: Eubouleus
characters.description: Swineherd who was swallowed up with his swine when Persephone was taken by Pluto.

characters.name: Pindar
characters.description: Greek lyric poet, quoted regarding the Eleusinian Mysteries.

characters.name: Cicero
characters.description: Roman statesman and orator, praised the Eleusinian Mysteries.

characters.name: Hierophant
characters.description: Priest who performed the highest rites at Eleusis.

characters.name: Priestess of Demeter
characters.description: Female priestess involved in the Eleusinian Mysteries.

characters.name: Elpenor
characters.description: Youngest companion of Odysseus, died falling from Circe's roof.

characters.name: Anticlea
characters.description: Mother of Odysseus, died of heartache longing for him.

characters.name: Aegisthus
characters.description: Lover of Clytemnestra, helped murder Agamemnon.

characters.name: Neoptolemus
characters.description: Son of Achilles, proven a worthy hero at Troy.

characters.name: Alcinoüs
characters.description: King of the Phaeacians, to whom Odysseus tells his story.

characters.name: Perimedes
characters.description: Companion of Odysseus who held sacrificial victims.

characters.name: Eurylochus
characters.description: Companion of Odysseus who held sacrificial victims.

characters.name: Autolycus
characters.description: Father of Anticlea, maternal grandfather of Odysseus.

characters.name: Laërtes
characters.description: Father of Odysseus.

characters.name: Sisyphus
characters.description: Condemned to roll a boulder uphill forever in the Underworld.

characters.name: Megara
characters.description: First wife of Heracles, killed by him in madness.

characters.name: Asopus
characters.description: River-god to whom Sisyphus revealed Zeus' secret about Aegina.

characters.name: Aegina
characters.description: Daughter of Asopus, carried off by Zeus.

characters.name: Er
characters.description: Brave man who died in war and returned to life to tell of the afterlife.

characters.name: Glaucon
characters.description: Interlocutor of Socrates in Plato's Republic.

characters.name: Proserpina
characters.description: Roman name for Persephone; depicted in Orpheus myth.

characters.name: Sibyl
characters.description: Prophetess who guided Aeneas in the Underworld.

characters.name: Dante
characters.description: Italian poet, author of the Inferno.

characters.name: Michelangelo
characters.description: Renaissance artist, painted the Last Judgment in the Sistine Chapel.

characters.name: Luca Signorelli
characters.description: Italian painter, created fresco cycle in Orvieto cathedral.

characters.name: Ardiaeus
characters.description: A tyrant of a city in Pamphylia a thousand years before Er's time; killed his aged parents and older brother and committed many other unholy deeds.

characters.name: Necessity
characters.description: Also called Ananke; the spindle of Necessity turns all the revolving spheres.

characters.name: Siren
characters.description: One of eight Sirens perched on each circle of the spindle, each uttering a single musical note, producing a unified harmony.

characters.name: Thamyras
characters.description: Soul that selected the life of a nightingale.

characters.name: Atalanta
characters.description: Soul that saw great honors attached to the life of a male athlete and took it.

characters.name: Epeus
characters.description: Soul that assumed the nature of a craftswoman.

characters.name: Thersites
characters.description: Soul that took the form of an ape.

characters.name: Misenus
characters.description: Aeneas' comrade who must be buried before Aeneas can enter the Underworld.

characters.name: Proserpine
characters.description: Roman name for Persephone; queen of the Underworld; the golden bough is sacred to her.

characters.name: Earth
characters.description: Personification of the earth; sister of Night.

characters.name: Eumenides
characters.description: Goddesses of vengeance; their iron chambers are in the Underworld.

characters.name: Dis
characters.description: Roman name for Hades; king of the Underworld.

characters.name: Palinurus
characters.description: Aeneas' helmsman who fell overboard and was killed; his unburied soul is seen by Aeneas in the Underworld.

characters.name: Centaurs
characters.description: Mythical creatures with the upper body of a human and lower body of a horse; dwell in the Underworld.

characters.name: Procris
characters.description: Wasted by love, resides in the Fields of Mourning.

characters.name: Eriphyle
characters.description: Displays wounds inflicted by a cruel son, resides in Fields of Mourning.

characters.name: Evadne
characters.description: Resides in Fields of Mourning.
major_myths: Theseus as Champion of the Oppressed

characters.name: Pasiphaë
characters.description: Resides in Fields of Mourning.

characters.name: Laodamia
characters.description: Resides in Fields of Mourning.

characters.name: Dido
characters.description: Queen of Carthage who committed suicide due to love for Aeneas.

characters.name: Sychaeus
characters.description: Former husband of Dido.

characters.name: Tydeus
characters.description: Greek warrior renowned in war, resides in fields for those who died in battle.

characters.name: Parthenopaeus
characters.description: Greek warrior renowned in war.

characters.name: Deïphobus
characters.description: Son of Priam who married Helen after death of Paris, killed by Menelaüs and Odysseus.

characters.name: Tisiphone
characters.description: Fury who guards the entrance to Tartarus, punishes the guilty.

characters.name: Rhadamanthus
characters.description: Judge in Tartarus who punishes crimes and recognizes treachery.

characters.name: Hydra
characters.description: Monster with fifty heads that resides within Tartarus.

characters.name: Teucer
characters.description: Ancient Trojan king, founder of the Trojan line.

characters.name: Ilus
characters.description: Trojan hero in Elysium.

characters.name: Assaracus
characters.description: Trojan hero in Elysium.

characters.name: Musaeus
characters.description: Poet in Elysium who guides the Sibyl and Aeneas to Anchises.

characters.name: Phoebus Apollo
characters.description: God of prophecy, music, and poetry; associated with the Sibyl and poets in Elysium.

characters.name: Eïoneus
characters.description: Father-in-law of Ixion; killed by Ixion when he came to collect a bride price.

characters.name: Dia
characters.description: Wife of Ixion, daughter of Eïoneus.

characters.name: Rhadamanthys
characters.description: One of the three judges of the Underworld.

characters.name: Aeacus
characters.description: One of the three judges of the Underworld; sometimes gatekeeper.

characters.name: Hermes Psychopompos
characters.description: Hermes in his role as guide of souls to the Underworld.

characters.name: Danaids
characters.description: The forty-nine daughters of Danaüs who killed their husbands on their wedding night; punished in Tartarus by attempting to carry water in bottomless containers.

characters.name: Allecto
characters.description: One of the three named Furies.

characters.name: Megaera
characters.description: One of the three named Furies.

characters.name: Aloadae
characters.description: Twin giants, sons of Iphimedeia and Poseidon; attacked Zeus by piling mountains; killed by Apollo.

characters.name: Iphimedeia
characters.description: Mother of the Aloadae; claimed their father was Poseidon.

characters.name: Hymen
characters.description: God of marriage, attended the wedding of Orpheus and Eurydice but gave bad omens.

characters.name: Ciconian women
characters.description: Thracian women who dismembered Orpheus in a Bacchic frenzy.

characters.name: Oeagrus
characters.description: Thracian river-god, possible father of Orpheus.

characters.name: Chronus
characters.description: First principle in Orphic theogony; described as a monstrous serpent with heads of bull, lion, and god's face.

characters.name: Adrasteia
characters.description: Personification of Necessity, accompanying Chronus.

characters.name: Kore
characters.description: Daughter of Zeus; mother of Dionysus by Zeus.

characters.name: Isis
characters.description: Egyptian goddess of fertility; mystery religion; search for Osiris and Horus; identified with many goddesses through syncretism.

characters.name: Osiris
characters.description: Husband and brother of Isis; dismembered by Seth.

characters.name: Seth
characters.description: Dismembered Osiris.

characters.name: Horus
characters.description: Child of Isis and Osiris.

characters.name: Serapis
characters.description: Associated with Isis; temples found throughout Roman world.

characters.name: Lucius
characters.description: Hero of Apuleius' Metamorphoses; turned into donkey; initiated into mysteries of Isis.

characters.name: Mithras
characters.description: Persian god of light and truth; champion of good against evil; miraculous birth from rock; slaying of bull.

characters.name: Atargatis
characters.description: Syrian goddess; earth mother like Cybele and Demeter; consort Hadad.

characters.name: Dushara
characters.description: Consort of Atargatis.

characters.name: Hadad
characters.description: Semitic god of thunder; consort of Atargatis.

characters.name: Baal
characters.description: Syrian sky-god.

characters.name: Jupiter Dolichenus
characters.description: Roman consort of Dea Syria; portrayed holding axe and thunderbolt, standing on bull.

characters.name: Bellona
characters.description: Identified with Isis.

characters.name: Castor
characters.description: One of the Dioscuri; identified with Cabiri.
major_myths: Quarrel of the Dioscuri with Idas and Lynceus

characters.name: Pollux
characters.description: One of the Dioscuri; identified with Cabiri.

characters.name: Argonauts
characters.description: Said to have been initiated into mysteries of Cabiri.

characters.name: Europa
characters.description: Phoenician princess, daughter of Agenor, abducted by Greeks (Cretans) to Crete.

characters.name: Alexander
characters.description: Trojan prince who took Helen from Sparta.

characters.name: Labdacus
characters.description: Ancestor of Oedipus; his family is cursed.

characters.name: Lycus
characters.description: Son of Chthonius (one of the Spartoi), regent then king of Thebes for twenty years.

characters.name: Chthonius
characters.description: One of the five Spartoi, father of Lycus and Nycteus.

characters.name: Antiope
characters.description: Daughter of Nycteus, loved by Zeus, fled to Sicyon while pregnant.

characters.name: Nycteus
characters.description: Brother of Lycus, father of Antiope, killed himself in despair.

characters.name: Chrysippus
characters.description: Son of Pelops, abducted by Laius.

characters.name: Thyestes
characters.description: Possibly depicted in the Chrysippus vase trying to stop the chariot.
major_myths: The Quarrel of Atreus and Thyestes

characters.name: Creon
characters.description: Regent of Thebes after Oedipus, later king.
major_myths: Theseus as Champion of the Oppressed

characters.name: Laodamas
characters.description: Son of Eteocles, king of Thebes.

characters.name: Polydorus
characters.description: According to Sophocles, became king after Pentheus.

characters.name: Zethus
characters.description: Son of Antiope and Zeus, twin of Amphion, king of Thebes.

characters.name: Dirce
characters.description: Wife of Lycus; tied to a bull by Amphion and Zethus; her blood created the fountain at Thebes.

characters.name: Thebe
characters.description: Wife of Zethus; the city Thebes was renamed in her honor.

characters.name: Polybus
characters.description: King of Corinth; adoptive father of Oedipus.

characters.name: Sphinx
characters.description: Monster with woman's face, lion's body, and bird's wings; sent by Hera; asked a riddle; killed itself when Oedipus answered.

characters.name: Menoeceus
